lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Greenhollow, courier inbound. Anything we need to declare?

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Oh, hello! Only if it's alive, on fire, or both. Pad two is free, next to the melon stall.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: We're a co-op out here. Farmers, fixers, a few people hiding from their families. No corporate stamps needed.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Fresh food, second-hand parts, fuel if the tanker's been. Prices are fair because I set them and I'm lovely.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: The bar by the silo doubles as a hiring hall. Good people, mostly. Don't let Rook near your controls.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Every week someone asks. The answer is still no, the cows are not for sale.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Take your time, courier. Nobody here's in a hurry, except the melons. They go off fast.

options.line: What can we pick up here?
Any spare hands looking for work?
I have to ask about the cows.
